events.title: Crusaders break out of Antioch and rout Kerbogha
events.description: Besieged in the city they had just taken, and inspired by the supposed discovery of the Holy Lance, the crusaders defeated the army of Kerbogha of Mosul. The road to Jerusalem lay open.
events.html: Besieged in the city they had just taken, and inspired by the supposed discovery of the Holy Lance, the crusaders defeated the army of Kerbogha of Mosul. The road to Jerusalem lay open.

events.title: Charles of Spain is elected Holy Roman Emperor
events.description: The electors chose Charles I of Spain over Francis I of France. As Charles V he ruled Spain, the Low Countries, Austria and much of Italy and the Americas.
events.html: The electors chose Charles I of Spain over Francis I of France. As Charles V he ruled Spain, the Low Countries, Austria and much of Italy and the Americas.

events.title: Jean-Jacques Rousseau is born in Geneva
events.description: Rousseau's The Social Contract and Émile shaped political thought and education, and his Confessions helped create modern autobiography. His ideas inspired French revolutionaries.
events.html: Rousseau's The Social Contract and Émile shaped political thought and education, and his Confessions helped create modern autobiography. His ideas inspired French revolutionaries.

events.title: Archduke Franz Ferdinand is assassinated in Sarajevo
events.description: Gavrilo Princip shot the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne and his wife Sophie. Austria-Hungary's ultimatum to Serbia set off the July Crisis and the First World War.
events.html: Gavrilo Princip shot the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne and his wife Sophie. Austria-Hungary's ultimatum to Serbia set off the July Crisis and the First World War.

events.title: Treaty of Versailles is signed
events.description: Germany signed the peace in the Hall of Mirrors, five years to the day after Sarajevo. It accepted territorial losses, disarmament and reparations, which fuelled lasting resentment.
